content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"No; the judge did not weigh a live chain-against-chain collision, but only noted that C4 pressed a limb the defender had already dropped, leaving no live link.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"“the collision weighs chain against chain by footing” — read as applying only to a live pressed link versus applying even after the targeted limb was dropped","why":"The judge’s reason is that the targeted limb was dropped and no live link remains, not a verse-by-verse or stating-verse resolution of a live collision."}
